name: KATANA DYNASTY
source:
Kaito, a renowned and respected samurai, finds himself thrust into a perilous battle when he inadvertently exposes the dark secrets of the mighty Matsuda family. Delving deeper into the family's history, Kaito falls in love with Lady Miyuki, the daughter of Lord Matsuda, who shares his disillusionment with her family's ruthless actions. Together, Kaito and Lady Miyuki navigate the treacherous world of politics, power, and love, as Kaito strives to uncover the truth about the Matsuda family and restore honor to the city.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753990/]Steam[/url]]
